AgentSessionRuntime [agent-session-runtime.ts]: retained runtime
|
|-- Current AgentSession [agent-session.ts]
|   |-- Agent [retained execution engine; see engine]
|   |   `-- prompt()/continue() -> agent-loop functions, not a loop object
|   |-- SessionManager [retained canonical history]
|   |   `-- Entry tree + selected leaf -> projected Agent messages
|   |-- ExtensionRunner [created and bound by _buildRuntime()]
|   |   `-- <- ResourceLoader extensions; binds session context and hooks
|   |-- Tool registries: definitions + wrapped callable implementations
|   |   `-- _refreshToolRegistry() -> installs Agent tool loadout
|   |-- Run bookkeeping and recovery controllers
|   |   |-- Preflight, pending messages, retry and settlement state
|   |   |-- Compaction / branch-summary / retry / bash cancellation
|   |   `-- compact()/recovery -> history entries; refresh Agent context
|   |-- Agent subscription and public listener collection
|   |   `-- Events -> extension hooks -> listeners; message_end -> history
|   |-- CacheWarmer [retained optional helper]
|   |-- Service references -> settingsManager / resourceLoader / modelRuntime
|   |-- API: prompt / steer / followUp / abort / compact / navigateTree
|   |   `-- state/messages/model getters; subscribe(listener) <- CLI hosts
|   `-- dispose() [synchronous cleanup; does not await settlement]
|       `-- Request aborts; invalidate contexts; detach; cancel/clean resources
|
|-- AgentSessionServices [cwd-bound infrastructure bundle; see services]
|   |-- cwd / agentDir / diagnostics
|   |-- SettingsManager [created or supplied]
|   |-- ResourceLoader [default factory creates DefaultResourceLoader]
|   `-- ModelRuntime [created or supplied; referenced by session + SDK]
|
|-- Host bindings: rebindSession / beforeSessionInvalidate callbacks
|   `-- <- InteractiveMode / runPrintMode / runRpcMode consume runtime
|
`-- Replacement operations: newSession / switchSession / fork
    |-- Before-switch/fork hooks may cancel
    |-- teardownCurrent() -> await session.abort() and idle settlement
    |-- -> session_shutdown hooks -> host UI invalidation -> dispose()
    |-- -> createRuntime factory -> apply new session/services
    |   `-- SDK createAgentSession() constructs Agent + AgentSession, not wrapper
    |       `-- Restored branch + settings + options -> model/thinking/tools
    `-- -> rebindSession(); optional withSession callback
